properties.message_511: On I-81 at mile marker 203 in the County of Rockbridge, motorists can expect delays due to a vehicle crash. The south right shoulder is closed.
On I-295 at mile marker 21.6 in the County of Henrico, motorists can expect delays due to a disabled vehicle. The south right shoulder is closed.
On I-64 at mile marker 282.2 in the City of Norfolk, near Northampton Boulevard, motorists can expect delays due to a disabled vehicle. The east right shoulder is closed.
